script: WORST starts to a new season in football history. Sheffield United got promoted to the Premier League back in 2023, and everyone knew they'd struggle, but they didn't just struggle. Their first ten games of the season brought them exactly one point, a single draw against Everton along with nine losses, including an 8-0 hammering at home to Newcastle. It was the beginning of a record the Premier League had never seen in over thirty years. After a loss to Arsenal in late October, Sheffield United officially had the worst start to a season in Premier League history through ten games, and they finished dead last on sixteen points and got relegated. They also let in 104 goals, the most any club has ever conceded in a single Premier League season. But breaking that record wasn't even the strangest part of this whole story. And if you're enjoying the video, please hit the follow button. This wasn't even the first time Sheffield United did it, because back in the 2020-21 season, that exact same club also took just one point from their opening ten games. So they hold the worst Premier League start ever, twice, completely by themselves. And that earlier side went even further, taking one point from their first thirteen matches. It's the worst start to any season in the entire history of English top-flight football, stretching back over one hundred years.
